submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Sb 0.305) had the highest measured EQE (0.0291%). EQE was 0.0253% at Sb 0.361, 0.0054% at Sb 0.503 and 0.0073% at Sb 0.671, and it was negative at Sb 0.195. The peak is therefore somewhere around Sb 0.27–0.36. XRD shows the same two-phase mixture across Sb 0.27–0.40. The phase with the strong 2.039 Å⁻¹ peak dominates at low Sb, and a second phase (peaks at 1.878, 2.37, 2.65 and 3.557 Å⁻¹) grows as Sb increases. As that second phase grows, EQE drops.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.0253%, lower than index 3; its XRD shows more of the second phase that grows with Sb
Measured 0.0054%, near the Pb2Sb2O7 (Sb 0.5) composition, much lower
Measured 0.0073%, near the PbSb2O6 composition, low
Measured a negative EQE (-0.0165%), so no net anodic photoresponse
Not measured for EQE; its XRD is nearly the same as index 3's, so no clear gain was expected. It is the main remaining uncertainty.
